note: Attacker-controlled bytes are wrapped in a buffer datastream, so later parsing reads directly from the supplied input.
This helper copies a line from the raw buffer into a caller buffer but does not always write a terminating NUL byte.
If the input line fills the destination buffer, the loop exits before the terminator path can reliably place a NUL at the end.
The terminator is written one byte past the last copied character, so a full-length line can leave the returned string unterminated.
A Rollei-style header routes parsing into parse_rollei, which consumes lines from the buffer stream.
parse_rollei reads metadata lines into a fixed 128-byte stack buffer via the datastream fgets/gets path.
When a line lacks a NUL terminator, strbuflen scans past the intended buffer boundary, causing out-of-bounds reads in the parser.
